tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List orders with filters by status, customer name, number, and created-date range. Returns (summary): pagination + array of {id, number, status, total, customer, phone, itemCount, createdAt}. Use detail:'full' for line items/delivery/payments, raw:true for the untouched payload.

filter_status.description: Filter by order status code (e.g. 'new', 'complete'). Call list_statuses for valid codes.

filter_date_from.description: Filter orders created on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

filter_date_to.description: Filter orders created on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

detail.description: Output verbosity: 'summary' (compact, default — saves tokens) or 'full' (all shaped fields incl. line items, delivery, payments).

raw.description: If true, return the untouched RetailCRM payload (for debugging; verbose).

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Get a single order by RetailCRM id or externalId. Returns a shaped order; detail:'full' adds items, delivery, payments, comments.

id.description: Order ID or externalId to retrieve

detail.description: Output verbosity: 'summary' (compact, default — saves tokens) or 'full' (all shaped fields incl. line items, delivery, payments).

raw.description: If true, return the untouched RetailCRM payload (for debugging; verbose).

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create an order with line items and delivery. Link an existing customer via customer_id/customer_external_id, or pass first_name (+phone/email) to create one inline. Returns {success, id, order?}.

first_name.description: Customer first name (omit only when linking by customer_id/customer_external_id)

customer_id.description: Link the order to an EXISTING customer by RetailCRM ID (mutually exclusive with inline name/phone/email)

customer_external_id.description: Link the order to an EXISTING customer by externalId

site.description: Site (store) symbolic code. Required on create/edit when the API key is scoped to multiple sites (see list_sites).

tools.name: update_order
tools.description: Update an order (status, customer, delivery, comments). Only the fields you pass are sent. Returns {success}.

customer_id.description: Re-link the order to an existing customer by RetailCRM ID

customer_external_id.description: Re-link the order to an existing customer by externalId

site.description: Site (store) symbolic code. Required on create/edit when the API key is scoped to multiple sites (see list_sites).

tools.name: orders_history
tools.description: Order change history incl. status transitions; supports incremental sync via filter_since_id and a date window. Returns {history[], pagination}.

filter_since_id.description: Return changes after this history entry ID (incremental sync)

filter_order_id.description: Restrict to a single order's history by RetailCRM ID

raw.description: If true, return the untouched RetailCRM payload (for debugging; verbose).

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List/search customers by name, email, phone, created-date. Returns (summary): pagination + array of {id, name, email, phone, ordersCount, totalSpent}. detail:'full' adds address/externalId/all phones.

detail.description: Output verbosity: 'summary' (compact, default — saves tokens) or 'full' (all shaped fields incl. line items, delivery, payments).

raw.description: If true, return the untouched RetailCRM payload (for debugging; verbose).

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Get a single customer by id or externalId. Returns a shaped customer; detail:'full' adds address and contact details.

id.description: Customer ID or externalId to retrieve

detail.description: Output verbosity: 'summary' (compact, default — saves tokens) or 'full' (all shaped fields incl. line items, delivery, payments).

raw.description: If true, return the untouched RetailCRM payload (for debugging; verbose).

tools.name: create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer with name, contacts, address, optional externalId. Returns {success, id}.

site.description: Site (store) symbolic code. Required on create/edit when the API key is scoped to multiple sites (see list_sites).

tools.name: update_customer
tools.description: Edit an existing customer (name, email, phones, address) by id or externalId. Only the fields you pass are sent. Returns {success}.

id.description: Customer ID or externalId to edit

site.description: Site (store) symbolic code. Required on create/edit when the API key is scoped to multiple sites (see list_sites).

tools.name: merge_customers
tools.description: Merge duplicate customers into a target; merged records are DELETED. Returns {success}.

result_customer_id.description: ID of the customer to keep (the merge target)

merged_customer_ids.description: IDs of customers to merge into the target (will be deleted)

tools.name: customers_history
tools.description: Customer field-change log for growth/churn signals and incremental sync. Returns {history[], pagination}.

filter_since_id.description: Return changes after this history entry ID (incremental sync)

raw.description: If true, return the untouched RetailCRM payload (for debugging; verbose).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List catalog products with filters by name, active, group, price range. Returns pagination + array of {id, name, article, active, url, groups, offers}.

filter_active.description: Filter by active status (true = active only)

filter_groups.description: Filter by product group ID (see list_product_groups)

raw.description: If true, return the untouched RetailCRM payload (for debugging; verbose).

tools.name: list_product_groups
tools.description: List product groups (category tree). Returns {productGroup[], pagination}.

filter_parent_group.description: Restrict to children of this parent group ID

tools.name: store_inventories
tools.description: Stock levels (and cost prices) per offer/warehouse. Use details:true for the per-store breakdown. Returns {offers[], pagination}.

site.description: Site (store) symbolic code. Required on create/edit when the API key is scoped to multiple sites (see list_sites).

tools.name: order_payment_create
tools.description: Record a payment against an order (amount, type, status, paid_at). Returns {success, id}.

order_id.description: Order RetailCRM ID the payment belongs to

site.description: Site (store) symbolic code. Required on create/edit when the API key is scoped to multiple sites (see list_sites).

tools.name: order_payment_edit
tools.description: Edit an existing order payment (amount/status/paid_at). Returns {success}.

site.description: Site (store) symbolic code. Required on create/edit when the API key is scoped to multiple sites (see list_sites).

tools.name: order_payment_delete
tools.description: Delete an order payment by id. Returns {success}.

tools.name: customer_notes_list
tools.description: List free-text notes attached to customers. Returns {notes[], pagination}.

filter_customer_id.description: Filter notes by customer RetailCRM ID

tools.name: customer_notes_create
tools.description: Add a note to a customer (by id or externalId). Returns {success, id}.

customer_id.description: Customer RetailCRM ID the note attaches to

site.description: Site (store) symbolic code. Required on create/edit when the API key is scoped to multiple sites (see list_sites).

tools.name: customer_notes_delete
tools.description: Delete a customer note by id. Returns {success}.

tools.name: tasks_list
tools.description: List follow-up tasks/reminders, filterable by status/performer/customer. Returns {tasks[], pagination}.

filter_customer.description: Filter by customer name/contact (text match — RetailCRM v5 has no numeric customer-ID task filter)

tools.name: tasks_create
tools.description: Create a task (text, due datetime, performer, linked order/customer). Returns {success, id}.

site.description: Site (store) symbolic code. Required on create/edit when the API key is scoped to multiple sites (see list_sites).

tools.name: tasks_edit
tools.description: Edit a task or mark it complete. Returns {success}.

site.description: Site (store) symbolic code. Required on create/edit when the API key is scoped to multiple sites (see list_sites).

tools.name: list_segments
tools.description: List customer segments (RFM/marketing cohorts). Returns {segments[], pagination}.

tools.name: list_costs
tools.description: List expense records (for margin/profit analytics) by date and cost group. Returns {costs[], pagination}.

tools.name: create_cost
tools.description: Create an expense record, optionally attributed to an order. Returns {success, id}.

order_id.description: Attribute the cost to an order RetailCRM ID

site.description: Site (store) symbolic code. Required on create/edit when the API key is scoped to multiple sites (see list_sites).

tools.name: files_list
tools.description: List files attached to orders/customers. Returns {files[], pagination}.

filter_order_id.description: Filter files attached to an order

filter_customer_id.description: Filter files attached to a customer

tools.name: files_get
tools.description: Get a file's metadata by id. Returns {file}.

id.description: File ID to fetch metadata for

tools.name: files_upload
tools.description: Upload a file (UTF-8 text or base64 binary). Returns {success, file}.

content.description: File content (UTF-8 text, or base64 when base64=true)

base64.description: Set true if `content` is base64-encoded binary

tools.name: list_statuses
tools.description: All order statuses (codes, names, groups, ordering). Call before filtering/updating orders by status.

raw.description: If true, return the untouched RetailCRM payload (for debugging; verbose).

tools.name: list_delivery_types
tools.description: All delivery types with codes, names, default costs.

raw.description: If true, return the untouched RetailCRM payload (for debugging; verbose).

tools.name: list_payment_types
tools.description: All payment types with codes and names.

raw.description: If true, return the untouched RetailCRM payload (for debugging; verbose).

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: All warehouses/stores (codes, names, types).

raw.description: If true, return the untouched RetailCRM payload (for debugging; verbose).

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: All sites/stores the API key can act on — use the returned code as the `site` param on multi-site create/edit.

raw.description: If true, return the untouched RetailCRM payload (for debugging; verbose).

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Valid country ISO codes for addresses/delivery.

raw.description: If true, return the untouched RetailCRM payload (for debugging; verbose).

tools.name: list_order_types
tools.description: All order types (codes/names) — valid values for create_order's order_type.

raw.description: If true, return the untouched RetailCRM payload (for debugging; verbose).

tools.name: list_order_methods
tools.description: All order methods (acquisition channels).

raw.description: If true, return the untouched RetailCRM payload (for debugging; verbose).

tools.name: get_orders_summary
tools.description: Period-scoped order summary: exact totalCount for the date range plus revenue, average order value, and status distribution aggregated over up to max_pages×100 orders (partial:true if the window exceeds that).

date_from.description: Start date for the summary period (YYYY-MM-DD)

date_to.description: End date for the summary period (YYYY-MM-DD)

filter_status.description: Restrict the summary to a single status code

max_pages.description: Pages of 100 orders to aggregate (revenue/status are computed over this window; the count is always exact)

tools.name: get_customers_summary
tools.description: Period-scoped new-customer count for a date range. Returns {period, newCustomers}.
